sizing_rule_7_5_8_1_2: When sizing a wet vent, the hydraulic load of the most downstream fixture (or symmetrically connected pair of fixtures) is NOT counted.
wet_vent_length: 7.5.2.1.(1): the length of a wet vent is not limited.
wet_vent_conditions_7_5_2_1: Not more than 2 water closets on the wet vent; 2 water closets connect at the same level (double sanitary T on a stack, double Y on a horizontal pipe).
Water closets must be downstream of all other fixtures.
Trap arms and fixture drains connecting to the wet vent: not more than NPS 2 (emergency floor drain excepted).
Multi-storey wet vents: the total drainage from any storey above the first storey is not more than 4 fixture units.
Not more than one horizontal offset; offset not more than 1.2 m (pipe NPS 2 or less) or 2.5 m (pipe larger than NPS 2).
No reduction in size in the wet-vented portion (except upstream of a floor drain).
circuit_venting_7_5_3_1: Circuit venting requires: a circuit vent connected; all circuit-vented fixtures on the same floor; no stack connected upstream of the circuit-vented fixtures.
Fixtures with outlets smaller than NPS 2 must be individually vented or individually circuit vented.

Relief vent: connected to the branch downstream of the most downstream circuit-vented fixture connection. Exceptions: a drain with a hydraulic load of not more than 6 FU may serve as the relief vent; a combined relief vent may serve 2 branches connected symmetrically, with not more than 8 fixtures between it and each circuit vent.

Additional circuit vents are required where the cumulative horizontal change of direction between vent connections exceeds 45 degrees, or more than 8 circuit-vented fixtures are connected between vent connections. A drain serving as an additional circuit vent is sized as a wet vent (Table 7.5.8.1) and is not less than NPS 2.
Minimum circuit-vented branch size: NPS 2 where traps are smaller than NPS 2; NPS 3 where traps are NPS 2 or larger.
Circuit vent size is set by Table 7.5.8.3 (total fixture units vs developed length) - the grid is not reproduced in this tool.
Additional circuit vents and relief vents (7.5.7.3.(1)): one NPS smaller than the circuit vent requires, but need not exceed NPS 2; also not smaller than Table 7.5.7.1 for the trap served.
